pillars.title: Operational Excellence

strengths.text: Structured observability with CloudWatch alarms and dashboard

findings.title: No CI/CD pipeline for linting, tests, and Terraform validation
findings.impact: Deployments are more manual and error-prone.
findings.recommendation: Add a CI pipeline that runs tests and Terraform validation on each change.

pillars.notes: Strong operational telemetry and runbook documentation; automation remains the main gap.

pillars.title: Security

strengths.text: Webhook signature verification and repository allowlist are implemented in code

findings.title: Publicly exposed entrypoint without WAF and without CMK-backed encryption controls
findings.impact: The public API endpoint and sensitive data stores remain exposed to a higher-than-necessary attack surface in a production-style deployment.
findings.recommendation: Add WAF and KMS CMK-based encryption for secrets, queues and data stores before production hardening.

alternative.summary: Place a WAF and private networking layer in front of the public endpoint while preserving the current serverless design.

pillars.notes: The codebase has solid anti-injection and least-privilege controls, but the production hardening gaps are significant.

pillars.title: Reliability

strengths.text: Idempotency, DLQ, and retries are implemented for the ingestion path

findings.title: No multi-region or disaster recovery design is present
findings.impact: A regional outage would disrupt the ingestion chain and documentation generation flow.
findings.recommendation: Add a DR strategy with replicated state, backup, and failover coverage.

pillars.notes: The core control flow is resilient within a single region.

pillars.title: Performance Efficiency

strengths.text: ARM64 and async execution reduce cost and improve latency

findings.title: The agent loads the entire tarball into memory, which limits large-repo handling
findings.impact: Very large repositories may hit memory or context constraints.
findings.recommendation: Stream and parallelize repository analysis for large repositories.

pillars.notes: Good baseline performance tuning for a serverless workflow.

pillars.title: Cost Optimization

strengths.text: Default Haiku model and bounded context reduce Bedrock spend

findings.title: Cost controls are mostly operational and not yet codified into budgets or policy
findings.impact: Spend can grow unexpectedly on large or repeated runs.
findings.recommendation: Add AWS budgets and prompt caching when available.

pillars.notes: The architecture stays scale-to-zero and is cost conscious by design.

pillars.title: Sustainability

strengths.text: Serverless, event-driven execution lowers idle consumption

findings.title: No explicit sustainability policy or energy-aware optimization is documented
findings.impact: Limited impact; the design is already relatively efficient.
findings.recommendation: Document sustainability targets and review model selection thresholds periodically.

pillars.notes: The service is already efficient by design, but no explicit sustainability governance is stated.

pillars.title: Architecture

strengths.text: The architecture cleanly separates ingress, orchestration, and runtime execution

findings.title: Architecture is strong but still single-region and not fully hardened for production
findings.impact: Availability and blast radius are not yet optimized for production-grade resilience.
findings.recommendation: Consider a multi-region and private-network evolution path for the runtime and ingress layers.

pillars.notes: The component model is coherent and well documented.

pillars.title: Terraform

strengths.text: Terraform modules are modular and structured by concern

findings.title: State backend and deployment flow are still manual and hard-coded
findings.impact: Repeatability and governance are weaker than they should be for larger teams.
findings.recommendation: Parameterize the backend and wire CI/CD for terraform init/validate/apply workflows.

pillars.notes: The IaC is structured reasonably well, but operationalization remains incomplete.

pillars.title: Modularity

strengths.text: The code is separated into testable modules such as docagent, lambdas, and Terraform modules

findings.title: The runtime and ingress modules still share some operational assumptions that could be hardened
findings.impact: Minor coupling remains between runtime and ingress deployment concerns.
findings.recommendation: Extract shared conventions and parameterized policies into a common module or policy layer.

pillars.notes: This is a solid modular design with clear boundaries.

pillars.title: Decoupling

strengths.text: The webhook and worker pattern decouples event ingress from runtime execution

findings.title: The runtime is still tightly coupled to a single ingress flow and region
findings.impact: It is less flexible for failover and alternate entry paths.
findings.recommendation: Introduce a more explicitly region-agnostic deployment contract and optional failover path.

pillars.notes: The queue and event-driven design are strong decoupling mechanisms.

pillars.title: Scalability

strengths.text: The design uses serverless scaling and concurrency controls

findings.title: Scale is bounded by the runtime and large-repo analysis limits
findings.impact: Very large or bursty workloads can still hit practical ceilings.
findings.recommendation: Introduce more streaming and batching for repository context processing.

pillars.notes: The system is built to scale on demand, but not unboundedly.

pillars.title: Maintainability

strengths.text: Test coverage is strong and the code is organized around clear modules

findings.title: The deployment and environment configuration still require manual coordination
findings.impact: Operational complexity is higher than ideal for a growing team.
findings.recommendation: Automate environment setup and documentation updates through a repeatable deployment process.

pillars.notes: The repository is relatively maintainable thanks to tests and structure.

roadmap.action: Add WAF and CMK-backed encryption controls for the ingress and data paths.
Introduce CI and parameterized backend configuration for Terraform.
Design a multi-region or DR strategy for the runtime and stateful services.
